$meta.artifact: N.E.R.D. — AppSheet ACRs table: structure + content snapshot (row-key verified)
$meta.purpose: Phase 1 prepopulation source and Phase 2 UI wiring reference.

inputs.fidelity: visually truncated on long text fields; Row ID column present and legible

inputs.covers: authoritative ACR row IDs via Products.ACRs

$meta.truncation_meaning: A trailing '…' means the value was cut off at the column boundary. Per-row list in _truncated_fields.
$meta.completeness: COMPLETE AT ROW LEVEL. 79 rows visible; Products.ACRs carries exactly 79 distinct references. No rows are missing.

row_key_verification.method: Row IDs were transcribed from the screenshot, then reconciled against the authoritative 79-ID set extracted from the Products CSV's ACRs column. Every match was independently corroborated by comparing the screenshot's Product ID against the CSV product that owns that ID.
row_key_verification.result: 79 of 79 resolved with product agreement on every one.
row_key_verification.note: row_id holds the AUTHORITATIVE value from the CSV. _row_id_transcribed preserves the raw screenshot reading for audit. Character-level OCR of these 22-char keys is unreliable (confusable I/l/1, O/0, S/5, B/8) — never use _row_id_transcribed as data.

$meta.significance: This is the first table where the parent-child join is fully reconstructable. The pattern generalizes: any AppSheet table whose keys appear in a parent CSV column can be key-recovered this way, without adding a temporary column in AppSheet or standing up API access.
blocking_questions: Full column name for 'ACR Last Updat…' is unknown.
Prepared-by enum vocabulary is observed-only; values beyond Internal/External/Unknown may exist.
'Temp: Contact Information' is named as temporary — confirm whether it should migrate at all or be dropped.

truncation_resolution.resolved: 2026-08-19 follow-up capture (5 screenshots, full-width columns, tooltip-verified on ui_row 73) resolved acr_name/acr_url/product_id truncation on all rows, and populated previously-null information/temp_contact_information fields.
truncation_resolution.verification_method: completed_by_url values already verified in this file (Level Access, Deque Systems, Magic EdTech, Zenyth, TPGi-Vispero at ui_row 43/50/52/55-58/60/65/68/72/73) were used as anchor points against the new screenshot's Completed By URL column. All 12 anchors matched in identical sequence, confirming the new capture follows ui_row order.
truncation_resolution.inferred_not_verified_note: For these ui_rows, information/temp_contact_information text was placed by positional sequence relative to the verified anchors above, not by an explicit row number or Row ID in the new capture (that screenshot has neither). Content plausibility supports the placement (e.g. the PhET note matches a PhET row, the two i-Ready OLD notes match the two i-Ready OLD rows) but it has not been independently confirmed the way the anchor rows have.

columns.name: acr_name
columns.notes: Report title. 12 rows use the sentinel 'Available on Request', which is a status, not a title — these rows have no acr_url. Maps to ACRReport.title.

columns.name: product_id
columns.notes: Stores the product NAME, matching Products.product_name. Same pattern as Resources.product_reference. Verified against the CSV on all 79 rows.

columns.name: acr_url
columns.notes: Empty on the 12 'Available on Request' rows plus 2 others. Maps to ACRReport.url. Note several rows point at software.psdschools.org and railslibraries.org, which are the two domains on the Gem's excluded-source list.

columns.name: date_published
columns.notes: Format 'M/D/YY'. Date only, no time — a third date format in this database. Maps to ACRReport.date.

columns.name: version
columns.notes: VPAT/ACR revision, not WCAG version. Maps to ACRReport.version.

columns.name: prepared_by
columns.notes: THIS IS ACRReport.preparation_type. Note the Unknown value — the N.E.R.D. schema declares only Internal/External, so migration needs a third state or a documented collapse rule.

columns.name: completed_by
columns.notes: Auditing firm. Maps to ACRReport.auditor_name. Sparse — populated only on externally-prepared reports.

columns.name: completed_by_url
columns.notes: Maps to ACRReport.auditor_url. Two rows use http:// rather than https://.

columns.name: information
columns.notes: Free-form editorial commentary. Includes at least one unresolved reviewer question ('I think this should be marked inte…' on PebbleGo) — editorial state, not settled data.

columns.name: temp_contact_information
columns.notes: Explicitly named 'Temp:'. Mixed content — bare emails, phone numbers, and 'N/A'. Migration disposition is a decision, not a mapping.

columns.name: row_id
columns.notes: THE KEY. 22 characters. This is the only table so far that exposes it. Values here are the authoritative CSV values, not the screenshot reading.

columns.name: acr_last_updated
columns.notes: Format 'M/D/YY, h:mm AM/PM' — matches both resource tables, differs from Products.

columns.name: added_to_site
columns.notes: Publication gate, same column concept as the Resources table. 53 checked, 26 unchecked — a third of ACRs are staged but not published. A dashboard must respect this.

relations.integrity: VERIFIED — 79 of 79 reconcile, with product agreement on every row

migration_decisions_required: ACRReport.preparation_type is typed Internal|External; this table carries a third value, Unknown, on 9 rows.

The 12 'Available on Request' rows have no URL. N.E.R.D.'s generator emits a 'None found' placeholder for empty acr_reports — these rows are a distinct third state (exists, not publicly linkable) that neither model represents.

Several acr_url values are on software.psdschools.org and railslibraries.org, both on the Gem's excluded-source-domains list. Migrating them imports citations the research pipeline is instructed never to produce.
